scripts.build: bun run manifest && bun run clean && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b --force
scripts.test: bun run build && node_modules/node/bin/node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.demo:hearth: sh apps/hearth/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b apps/hearth --force && node_modules/node/bin/node apps/hearth/dist/main.js
scripts.demo:quest: bun run manifest && sh apps/quest/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b apps/quest --force && node_modules/node/bin/node apps/quest/dist/main.js
scripts.demo:roam: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b packages/harngine apps/roam --force && node_modules/node/bin/node apps/roam/dist/main.js
scripts.demo:muse: bun run manifest && sh apps/muse/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b packages/harngine apps/muse --force && node_modules/node/bin/node apps/muse/dist/cli.js
scripts.demo:muse:live: bun run manifest && sh apps/muse/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b packages/harngine apps/muse --force && node_modules/node/bin/node apps/muse/dist/cli.js --live
